name: sum_of_evens_up_to_n
mechanism: synth4_induce_toggle_accumulator (friendly_cli/lib/synth4_toggle_search.patlang) -- a GENERIC extension to the induction search space, directly implementing the user's own idea: 'can it learn to toggle a truth value; if so it can count in twos and should be able to handle the sum of evens...?' Searches a metarule shape with a threaded flag argument that toggles each recursive step (background relation toggle(true,false)/toggle(false,true)), conditionally combining into the running total only on the 'true' branch. Not written for this problem specifically -- searches over (chain_pred, combine_pred, start_flag) candidate triples.
scope_note: IMPORTANT: this is sum-of-evens-UP-TO-N (an integer accumulation: target(N,Total,Flag)), NOT the curriculum's original sum_of_evens(xs) spec over an arbitrary LIST. That gap (the relational engine has no list encoding -- solve()/rule_add() unify over flat strings only) remains genuinely unclosed. This entry closes the toggle/parity-tracking piece the user specifically asked about, honestly scoped to that.

search_candidates_tried.note: pred2 (step-by-2) and times (multiplication) were DELIBERATE DECOYS, same as sum_1_to_n_via_search. Search correctly found (pred1, plus, true).

found_clause:
rule target(X, Y, "v:true") :- zero(X), zero(Y).
rule target(X, Y, "v:true") :- pred1(X, X2), toggle("v:true", F2), target(X2, Y2, F2), plus(Y2, X, Y).
rule target(X, Y, "v:false") :- pred1(X, X2), toggle("v:false", F2), target(X2, Y, F2).
blind_check_result: ALL 5 PASSED (after extending background pred1/plus fact range from 30 to 150 -- an early run failed target(20,110) purely due to insufficient fact range for plus's recursion, the same known bug class as sum_1_to_n_via_search's earlier development, not a search-logic flaw)
bug_found_and_fixed_during_this_work: synth4_clauses_for initially hardcoded the literal predicate name 'chain' instead of using the chain_pred parameter -- caught immediately via a hand-verification of the intended-correct (pred1,plus,true) triple returning all-false, fixed before the real search was trusted.
provenance: direct response to user's question: 'can it learn to toggle a truth value; if so it can count in twos and should be able to handle the sum of evens...?' -- built as a generalization of the toggle mechanism already implicit in is_even's own induction, per the standing rule of writing SEARCH INFRASTRUCTURE only, never a target predicate's own clause body.
